title_or_table: County Business Patterns, United States, NAICS 813410 (civic and social organizations)
observation_period: Annual, 1998 to 2023; employees counted in the pay period including March 12
universe_or_base: Establishments with paid employees classed in NAICS 813410
vintage: CBP annual releases 1998 to 2023 (2023 released in 2025), read through the data API
qualification: County Business Patterns counts establishments with paid employees; groups run by volunteers alone are not counted, so the series tracks paid civic organizations, not membership or volunteering. NAICS revisions in 2002, 2007, 2012 and 2017 kept this code and its title; the API serves 2023 under the 2017 code list

naics_vintage.description: NAICS edition the year uses in the API

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, civic and social organizations (NAICS 813410), 1998 to 2023, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Establishments with paid employees only; employees counted in mid-March.
breaks_in_series: County Business Patterns has been tabulated on the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) since the 1998 data year; earlier years used the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC), so the series starts in 1998. The 2017 to 2023 data use 2017 NAICS, and earlier years earlier NAICS editions (U.S. Census Bureau, County Business Patterns, Methodology, https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/cbp/technical-documentation/methodology.html, read November 12, 2026).
